question: In ________ method of calculating national income, we calculate the aggregate annual value of goods and services produced (if a year is the unit of time).
solution:
The correct answer is __**product.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The method of **calculating national income **by considering the aggregate annual value of **goods and services** produced is known as the production or **product method.**
 
• It is one of the three methods used for **calculating national income,** the other two being the** income method** and the** expenditure method.**
